name: 随机等待延迟
description: 在执行签到前增加随机等待时间，打乱固定执行周期，避免并发请求。
author: TG-SignPulse

params_schema.name: min_seconds
params_schema.label: 最小延迟(秒)
params_schema.description: 随机延迟等待时长的下限

params_schema.name: max_seconds
params_schema.label: 最大延迟(秒)
params_schema.description: 随机延迟等待时长的上限

params_schema.name: distribution
params_schema.label: 分布模型
params_schema.description: 随机数采样概率分布模型

description_en: Injects randomized delay before signing actions to avoid concurrency and fixed-interval patterns.
features: Uniform and Gaussian randomized delay sampling
Automatic min/max bound swapping and non-negative clamping
